description_en: Queries the trend of session counts at various time points on a specified date, returned in 10-minute intervals
description_zh: 查询指定日期内各时间点的会话数量趋势，按 10 分钟粒度返回
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center query-session-data --appstream-center-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-instance-group-id aig-89ibriac2wudyph38 --stat-date 20261106 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySessionData

parameters.help_en: The region ID, which is a common request parameter for the gateway. The region actually used to filter session data in this operation is specified by BizRegionId
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID，网关通用请求参数。本接口实际用于过滤会话数据的地域由 BizRegionId 指定
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The delivery group ID, used to filter session data for a specified delivery group. If not provided, the summary of session data for all delivery groups under the current account is returned
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID，用于过滤指定交付组的会话数据。不传时返回当前账号下所有交付组的会话数据汇总
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The statistical date in the yyyyMMdd format (without hyphens), such as 20261106. If not provided, the data for yesterday is queried by default. Only dates within the last 90 days are supported. If the date exceeds 90 days or the format is invalid, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 统计日期，格式为 yyyyMMdd（不含短横线），例如 20261106。不传时默认查询昨天的数据。仅支持查询最近 90 天内的日期；超出 90 天或格式非法时返回参数错误
parameters.name: stat_date

parameters.help_en: The business region ID, which specifies the region for which to query session data. The server uses this value as the region filter condition for session data. If not provided, no region filtering is applied, and the summary of session data for all regions is returned
parameters.help_zh: 业务地域 ID，指定要查询会话数据的地域，服务端以该值作为会话数据的地域过滤条件。不传时不按地域过滤，返回所有地域的会话数据汇总
parameters.name: biz_region_id

schema.description_en: The response for querying session trend data, which includes the request ID, return code, return message, and session trend data list
schema.description_zh: 查询会话趋势数据的响应，包含请求 ID、返回码、返回信息和会话趋势数据列表

Code.description_en: The return code. It is empty when the request is successful and data is found. NO_DATA is returned when the query result is empty. A corresponding error code is returned when the request fails. For example, InvalidParameter.DateFormat is returned when the format of the statistical parameter is invalid
Code.description_zh: 返回码。请求成功且查询到数据时为空；查询结果为空时返回 NO_DATA；请求失败时返回对应错误码，例如统计参数格式非法时返回 InvalidParameter.DateFormat

IndexData.description_en: The list of session trend data, sorted in ascending order by hour and minute. An empty array is returned when there is no session data on the specified date, and the return code is NO_DATA
IndexData.description_zh: 会话趋势数据列表，按小时、分钟升序排列。当指定日期没有会话数据时返回空数组，此时返回码为 NO_DATA

Hh.description_en: The hour to which the session data belongs, with a value range of 00 to 23 (full hours)
Hh.description_zh: 会话数据所属的小时，取值范围 00-23（整点小时）

Mi.description_en: The minute to which the session data belongs, aggregated in 10-minute intervals, with a value range of 00 to 50 (namely 00, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50)
Mi.description_zh: 会话数据所属的分钟，按 10 分钟粒度统计，取值范围 00-50（即 00、10、20、30、40、50）

SessionCntMi.description_en: The total number of sessions within the hour and minute interval (10-minute granularity)
SessionCntMi.description_zh: 该小时与分钟区间（10 分钟粒度）内的会话数量汇总值

StatDate.description_en: The statistical date to which the session data belongs, in the yyyyMMdd format, consistent with the request parameter StatDate
StatDate.description_zh: 会话数据所属的统计日期，格式为 yyyyMMdd，与请求参数 StatDate 一致

Message.description_en: The return message. It is empty when the request is successful. A corresponding error description is returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 返回信息。请求成功时为空；请求失败时返回对应的错误描述信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, used to locate call records and troubleshoot issues. The example is a partially desensitized value
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于定位调用记录和排查问题。示例为部分脱敏值
